subtitle: Turn-by-turn directions, with your head up.
longDescription:
Find your destination and follow turn-by-turn navigation with Mentra Maps. See your route in the Mentra App and receive visual or spoken directions on supported smart glasses.

Search for a place, choose a route, and keep track of upcoming turns while you travel. Maps requires an internet connection and location access, including background location while navigation is active. Available output depends on your glasses.
